men and women differ in their financial risk tolerance, but the difference is explained by their different experiences.

(1) women take less financial investment risk than men, and (2) the gender differences in risk tolerance cannot be explained by the effects of age, education, employment, or the effect of being out of the labor force.
men are more risk tolerant than women in investment decisions, but this is not due to gender, but rather to the fact that men are more likely to have previous investment experience.
